findings.title: Executor loses the task specification at the step boundary
findings.classification: observed input information loss; independently reproduced dependency invariant
findings.evidence: All twelve S2 Executor contexts lack the source task's device, gold and directional rules. Replacing the immutable request by another real public task leaves the bootstrap, protocol and bound facts identical while holding the step/history fixed.
findings.limit: The observed task stopped before code generation. It is proven that necessary task information is absent, not that a measured wrong algorithm was executed.

findings.title: Parameter rejection history disappears on tool reselection
findings.evidence: Six complete canonical Selector inputs have identical SHA; each set of three votes selects move_file. Same-selection Executor retries see the rejection, whereas fresh-selection inputs lose it. Eleven missing-source rejections plus one invalid operation envelope exhaust twelve consecutive failures.

findings.title: Eligibility checks only the destination of multi-path operations
findings.classification: observed structural contract mismatch; local probe reproduced for copy and move
findings.evidence: An entirely empty workspace still makes copy_file and move_file eligible because their destinations may be missing; actual preflight rejects the required source. Compatible target hints contain only destination paths.
findings.limit: A missing destination alone is not sufficient to exclude copy/move: legitimate sources may exist outside the destination scope. Complete and unknown source discovery must remain distinct.

findings.title: move_file source deletion is omitted from step write-scope checks
findings.classification: local preflight reproduction and complete execution call-path inspection; not observed as a production mutation
findings.evidence: With write_roots=[main.py], a move from existing source.dat to main.py passes preflight although the source is outside the write scope and move deletes it. A copy of the same source is the valid control. No move or copy was executed in the probe.

findings.title: Trace reconstruction drops incomplete discovery metadata
findings.classification: local production-builder and trace-builder invariant reproduction
findings.evidence: Harness and production progress both retain discovery_complete=false; _frontier_facts omits the argument when rebuilding the target contract, defaults it to true, then raises durable Harness target contract cannot be rebuilt. Shared path affects Selector and Executor extraction.
findings.limit: R3's actual target discovery was complete. This is an additional data-path defect, not the explanation for the existing six-row R3 candidate set.

findings.title: Executor instructions conflate copied evidence with newly authored content
findings.classification: verified prompt/runtime semantic mismatch; behavioral effect unmeasured
findings.evidence: The shared prompt instructs code/text mutation literals to be copied from observations, while write_file accepts newly authored content with zero checked source bindings. New implementation and exact source extraction require different argument-authority semantics.

findings.title: Native generation traces lack full server input-token evidence
findings.classification: observed evidence gap; local request propagation omission
findings.evidence: All fourteen Executor contexts reconstruct with bound checkpoint chains, but zero contain complete server input token proof. Native state_generate does not propagate RuntimeSettings.return_token_ids. Selector's separate endpoint has complete evidence for its six automatic rows.
findings.limit: Adding a client flag alone is not established to make the deployed server export its complete recurrent input. This concerns later Native-role training, not the current Selector evidence gate.

findings.title: Independent roles retain a physical dependency on the Executor checkpoint service
findings.classification: R1 production outage amplification; current call-path inspection
findings.evidence: The Controller prepares/imports Executor Native State before Selector and before independent audit/finalization. R1 therefore never called healthy Selector after Executor State initialization failed. Recovery identity and nonretryable-error handling were fixed, but this physical dependency remains.

historical_fixed_amplifiers.problem: Native recovery identity omitted and deterministic HTTP 400 retried eight times per task
Possible audit gaps presented as negative facts; six contradictory repairs accepted and fed back to repeated observation
historical_fixed_amplifiers.limit: R3's two observation audits passed; no claim of general semantic accuracy
